What can you do on this tab?
If “Progress Bar” is on in Product Settings, the colors, height, and labels of the bar that fills toward the goal are managed here.
Three layers: confirmed (after payment), cart pending, typed-amount preview. The goal amount is in the “Goal amount” field on the product card.
Colors and layers
Confirmed / cart / typed slice colors and the card surface.

Confirmed (filled) bar
Amount confirmed after payment.
Cart pending bar
Slice for the amount sitting in the cart, not yet paid.
Typed amount (draft)
The front end uses the soft-ink slice fill color; this field is a legacy / fallback color.
Percent badge background
On the front end the percent has no background; this is for legacy compatibility.

Size and animation
Bar height and goal celebration.
